pages.text: Long eels of stretched matter, in the drift and the depths. They circle, then lunge. When one bites it $(danger)grabs on$() and drags you down toward the singularity.$(br2)$(good)Hit it$() to make it let go.
pages.title: Spaghettifiers
Spaghettifier drops
pages.text: Mass Shards, and sometimes a $(item)Recording: Spaghettification$().

Sparks of Hawking radiation drifting everywhere above the line. Harmless. They $(thing)evaporate$() over a few minutes, shrinking and dimming until they're gone.$(br2)Catch one early for more $(item)Hawking Motes$(). Sometimes it leaves a $(item)Recording: Hawking Radiation$().
pages.title: Hawking Wisps
Drifters
pages.text: The $(l:safety/dark_energy_zone)Drifters$() of the dark energy zones drift through the upper layers too.
